## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (83%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and second-model agreement support it; concept explanations here are weak.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 83%, InSitu 16% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Invasive [F5] | Moderate; two InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce gland/tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Gland formation scarce overall; region 11 has the most [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 5, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score, modest association in concept model · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 4, 5, 8) · context · 72% neoplastic nuclei, 97th percentile of reference [F7] · Measured
- **Nuclear size** (regions 4, 5, 8) · context · Mean area at reference minimum; size variation high · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Largest concept term, but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60): faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect vs random is 0.002 (CI includes 0): not shown faithful. Mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- True class is InSitu: 16% probability, 2 of 5 similar cases, duct-confined signal in regions 2, 6.
- Cell measurements come from only 3 of 12 regions (4, 5, 8); other regions may differ.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 5, 9** — Count mitoses directly; the model's mitosis score failed its spot check.
2. **Regions 2, 6** — Look for ducts with atypical cells but no stromal invasion.
3. **Region 11** — Gland and pleomorphism concepts rank here, but region risk is 1%; confirm tissue type.
